Photos are the dealer's first listing photo, cut to 4:3; stock_image marks a manufacturer render used where the dealer has no photograph. Each car carries its first six dealer photographs (assets/img/vdp/<stock>/) with their sources, the dealer's "popular features" list, and the spec fields from the JSON-LD; dealer_url is the listing, page is this site's vehicle page. spin: 24 frames of the dealer's 360 (DealerMade Next HD viewer, "Middle" camera, evenly picked from ~54 positions), 1000 wide; spin_source records the picks. price_disclaimer is the dealer's own "Details" text beside every price; lease_terms (and lease_terms_raw) are the dealer's "Details" beside each lease, parsed.
